notes.title: Big September Update
notes.notes:
This is a huge update that includes tons of bug fixes and tweaks to the missions to make them more fun.
- Improved several missions to make them less chaotic and more engaging firefights (For example, the bomb mission that takes place on bridge, the train station mission, and many more )
- Improved Enemy AI to behave more intelligently indoors. When a player opens a door, the enemy will react to the door and try to run for cover.
- Added more dynamic movements to the enemy AI. They now dive for cover, making them harder to hit and giving the firefights a cinematic flair.
- Fixed a bug with dying on ladders, the player is stuck on the ladder
- Fixed a bug with drones sometimes flying too high..
- Fixed bug with the yellow flashing icon that locates hostages sometimes not appearing
- Reduced memory usage by cleaning up and consolidating a lot of assets
- Fixed annoying bug where the enemies in vehicles would sometimes appear to be floating in mid-air like aliens
- Fixed footsteps not working for characters holding melee weapons
- Reduced the stutter that occurs when flashbangs go off
- Fixed a bug related to players with high ping would sometimes purchase items in the store TWICE, if they clicked on a buy button

notes.title: Major May Update
notes.notes:
This update is the culmination of the last few months of work by our team. Thank you to all of the player's who gave us feedback and we hope you enjoy the massive improvements to the game.

Improved Enemy AI
We spent a great deal of time re-working our enemy AI so that they find better use of cover. Enemies will also be aware of their teammates and move to cover positions that take into account the positions of their teammates. They will also try to flank the player if the opportunity presents itself.
We also fixed a nasty bug that was causing the enemies pathfinding to pick routes that would result in the enemy sometimes running straight at the player, resulting in zombie-like behaviour.
[previewyoutube=8jnAkJ_CzC0;full][/previewyoutube]


Add several new missions
New missions take place in exciting locations such as City Hall, Industrial Factory, Classical Library, Commercial Strip Mall. In total, there are almost 40 unique missions taking place across two large open maps. This patch also includes graphical improvements to many of the existing missions.
[previewyoutube=j0PULPJ2brQ;full][/previewyoutube]


New weapons
We've added several new guns such as:
1) BT USW Full Auto pistol
2) 870 Shorty pump action shotgun
3) BT APC9 Submachine gun
4) HK M320 Grenade Launcher

We also added the ability for the player to carry three weapons. One primary, one secondary ( pistol) and a third weapon (small SMG / small shotgun/ grenade launcher)
[previewyoutube=Y4-wDt4DsAs;full][/previewyoutube]


Tons of bug fixes and quality of life improvements
We made it much easier for new players to play the game by adding pop-up hints that appear explaining the various game mechanics.
We made the driving portion easier by showing the player the ideal route to take to reach his next mission. We also made the driving controls much easier for new players.
Due to player feedback commenting that it can be very difficult to spot enemies in a crowd of civilians, we've added an option that briefly highlights enemies when they attack the player. This makes them much easier to spot for less skilled players. This feature can be turned off for players who prefer a more realistic gameplay experience.

notes.title: Alpha Respone Update ( Feb. 20, 2025 )

This update includes the following features and improvements.

- Two new missions have been added. A Hostage rescue mission taking place in a city Hall building and a bomb defusal mission taking place in an apartment building
- Added 3 new weapons:  M320 grenade launcher ( useful for taking down vehicles such as helicopters ), 870 shotgun,  APC9 SMG.  These new weapons can be equipped in the "tertiary" slot, which allows players to carry a total of 3 weapons. A primary / secondary (pistol) / tertiary 

- fixed bug with player switching seats when the car is full.
- Reduced amount of enemies that get spawned as it was overwhelming the players on Normal Difficulty
- Made the hit indicator that appears in the middle of the screen more visible and easier for players to know where they're getting hit from
- Added ability for players to command civilians to get out of the way!
- Added sound occlusion so that AI characters footsteps and sounds do not sound as loud when the character is behind a wall.
- Optimized the performance of the rendering of all of the highrise apartment buildings in the level
- Added ability for passengers to lean out of windows when they're in a car. This will allow passengers to shoot at targets easier
- Added glowing outlines to actors so they can be seen easier behind walls. This makes it easier to find teammates or important objects suc has ammo bags
- Added enemy Road blocks that appear during the driving portion 
- Fixed bug with AMMO ui sometimes disappearing
- Removed some unnecessary features that were harming performance ( ie. the MBS LOD optimizer )
- The laser beam addon now shows a green laser beam and reduces the gun's random spread
- Improved various special fx. when the player shoots at objects in the world
- Made it easier to find and navigate to the supply crate when a mission ends, so the player can purchase new equipment
- Improved the code that was randomly selecting missions. It will now try to pick missions that have not been played by the players 
- Fixed a bug with engine sound playing when player changed seats
- Improved the melee weapon impact F/X
- Fixed some bugs with the weapon store UI
- Made the enemies easier to spot when they fire their guns. This will make the enemy stand out more and easier to spot amongst the civilians
- Spawned smoke at enemy spawn points when new wave of enemy is spawned. This will prevent players from camping the spawn points
- Fixed a nasty bug with player controlled vehicles by that was causing them to be randomly destroyed while a player was still in them.
- Improved the mission briefing flow that occurs when a player starts a new mission 
- fixed the scoring for the hostage rescue mission.

1) Added a new feature, Team Leader.  The player designated as a team leader will lead his team and all other team members are encouraged to stay near him. Team leaders can revive quicker and the ammo/health will spawn near team leaders. This is to encourage players to stick together especially during missions where they are commonly wandering independently.
